articles.title: Influential research firm that caused AI stock meltdown lays out Hyperliquid as 'compelling' idea
articles.snippet: Unlike most crypto, Hyperliquid actually generates cash flow and has a token buyback mechanism, says Citrini Research

articles.title: Sam Bankman-Fried officially asks Trump for a presidential pardon
articles.snippet: The fallen crypto mogul serving a 25-year sentence filed a clemency petition, betting on Donald Trump's history of crypto pardons even though the president had told him not to count on one.

articles.title: Claude Code Vulnerability Could Let Attackers Steal Credentials From GitHub, Says Microsoft
articles.snippet: Researchers say prompt injection attacks could manipulate AI coding agents to access sensitive credentials stored in software development pipelines.
